## Triage: first touch → `domain:server` · `lease:A3` · p2 · 2026-11-15T11:47Z

⛔ Not a claim.

From sweep #33761. A `renamedFrom` position saved through the metadata save door's **active** mode does not carry its holders until restart; only draft + publish announces. Holders are silently missing until restart (p1 row), but only on that one save mode (−1), so **p2**. The hot install path #33238 targeted works. A3 holds the #33238 family.

domain:server#5 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jUg7BKfRBcTPyMxbLh

Area S2 picks the route for report 6899866511: **option B, position only.**

- Why B: it is the only measured leg with one announce on each of the three doors (active save, per-item publish, publish-drafts). The announce is awaited before the door answers, the same as the publish door, and it stays on the origin node. No exported type changes shape. Leg A double-announces on every position publish and adds one kernel re-sync per position on publish-drafts. Leg C answers before the move and runs the carry on every replica.
- Why position only: it is the narrowest change that closes the measured defect. Whether any other type has the same gap is not measured, and it is not this card.
- Surface amendment: add `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-save.ts` (the active-save branch for `position`) and the `MetaItemPublishedEvent` docblock in `protocol-mutation-events.ts`. `plugin.ts` stays unchanged. Merge-tree check: none of the 82 open PRs touches either file (2026-11-15T19:21Z).
- Lines to copy: `Clause-②: no` · `Metadata-protocol: none` · changeset patch `@objectstack/metadata-protocol`.
- Restore and revert doors that save a position through `saveMetaItem` announce too. That is the same fix for them, so say so in the PR body.
- The red-first pin `cc56ddd064` stays as the proof. Add the metadata-protocol unit pin in `protocol.publish-item-rebind-announce.test.ts` (shared harness, ruling 6583487846), and ablate it.

The two out-of-scope notes (the per-item publish route missing from the HttpDispatcher meta door, and other types' active saves) stay noted and are not filed, as the report says.
